vision.name: Saiyan Reinforcements
vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
(If the highest power level on your MP's Level 4 is 500,000 or less, you may banish this card from your hand as an action to search your discard pile for a card that can attach to your MP and place it into play attached.)
[Attack] Physical attack.
Search your Life Deck for a [Trait:Saiyan] Ally and play it.
DAMAGE: 3 stages.
(Created by Trevor Cox, OP2 East Kai Champion)
vision.note: Organized Play card (OP2); prints a design credit line; inline icon zoomed: green S badge (Saiyan)
